question: The Union Territory of Lakshadweep has __ __ inhabited islands as of March 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is **'__10__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• A single-district Union Territory, **Lakshadweep** has an area of** 32 square kilometres** and consists of ten inhabited islands, 17 deserted islands connected by islets, four newly constructed islets, and one unoccupied island.
 
• Kavaratti, Agatti, Amini, Kadmat, Kiltan, Chetlat, Bitra, Andrott, Kalpeni, and Minicoy are the **inhabited islands**.
 
• It is a single-district Union Territory that consists of** ten** populated islands, three reefs, and 12 atolls.
